description: E-commerce businesses including DTC brands, online retailers, and multi-channel sellers

common_processes.name: Order Management & Processing
common_processes.description: Receiving, processing, and tracking orders from multiple channels (website, marketplaces, wholesale)
ai_opportunities: Automated order routing and fulfillment assignment
AI-powered fraud detection on incoming orders
Smart order prioritization based on shipping deadlines

common_processes.name: Inventory Management & Forecasting
common_processes.description: Tracking stock levels, reordering, managing multiple warehouses, and preventing stockouts or overstock
ai_opportunities: Dead stock identification and markdown recommendations

common_processes.name: Customer Service & Support
common_processes.description: Handling inquiries, complaints, returns, exchanges, and order status updates
ai_opportunities: AI chatbot for common questions (order status, shipping, returns)

common_processes.name: Product Listing & Content Management
common_processes.description: Creating product descriptions, photography, SEO optimization, and multi-channel listing management
ai_opportunities: Automated image background removal and enhancement
SEO keyword optimization for product pages
AI-powered A/B testing of product copy

common_processes.name: Fulfillment & Shipping
common_processes.description: Picking, packing, shipping, and tracking orders; managing carrier relationships
ai_opportunities: Automated carrier selection for best rate/speed
Delivery exception prediction and proactive customer notification

common_processes.name: Returns & Exchanges Processing
common_processes.description: Managing return requests, processing refunds, restocking, and analyzing return reasons
ai_opportunities: Self-service returns portal with AI recommendations
Automated return approval for low-risk cases
AI analysis of return reasons to improve product listings
Smart exchange suggestions to retain revenue

common_processes.name: Email Marketing & Customer Retention
common_processes.description: Email campaigns, automated flows, segmentation, and lifecycle marketing

common_processes.name: Pricing & Promotions Management
common_processes.description: Setting prices, running promotions, managing discounts, and competitive price monitoring
ai_opportunities: Dynamic pricing based on demand and competition

common_processes.name: Analytics, Reporting & Data-Driven Decisions
common_processes.description: Tracking KPIs (conversion rate, AOV, CLV, ROAS), generating reports, attribution analysis, and identifying growth opportunities from data
ai_opportunities: AI-powered anomaly detection in sales and traffic

common_processes.name: Multi-Channel & Marketplace Selling
common_processes.description: Listing products across multiple channels (own store, Amazon, eBay, social commerce), syncing inventory, pricing, and orders
ai_opportunities: Automated listing creation and sync across channels
Centralized order management with smart routing
Channel performance comparison and budget allocation

industry_specific_challenges: High cart abandonment rates (70% industry average)
Rising customer acquisition costs across paid channels
Managing inventory across multiple sales channels
Increasing return rates especially in fashion/apparel
Competing with Amazon and large marketplace sellers
Shipping cost pressure and customer free-shipping expectations
Building customer loyalty and repeat purchases

pain_points.name: Cart Abandonment
pain_points.description: Shoppers add items to cart but leave without completing purchase
pain_points.impact: 70% of carts are abandoned, representing massive lost revenue
pain_points.ai_potential: AI-powered multi-channel recovery campaigns can recapture 10-15% of abandoned carts

pain_points.name: Rising Customer Acquisition Cost
pain_points.description: Cost to acquire new customers through paid channels continues to increase
pain_points.impact: CAC has increased 50-100% over the past 3 years for most e-commerce brands
pain_points.current_solutions: Diversifying channels, organic content, referral programs
pain_points.ai_potential: AI audience targeting, lookalike modeling, and creative optimization can reduce CAC by 15-30%

pain_points.name: Customer Service Overload
pain_points.description: High volume of repetitive inquiries about order status, shipping, returns
pain_points.impact: 60-70% of support tickets are repetitive questions that could be automated
pain_points.current_solutions: FAQ pages, basic chatbots, support team scaling
pain_points.ai_potential: AI chatbots can handle 40-60% of inquiries automatically, reducing support costs by 30-50%

pain_points.name: Inventory Mismanagement
pain_points.description: Stockouts on popular items while overstocking slow-movers ties up capital
pain_points.impact: Stockouts cause 4-8% revenue loss; overstock ties up 20-30% more capital than needed
pain_points.current_solutions: Manual spreadsheets, basic reorder points, gut feeling
pain_points.ai_potential: AI demand forecasting reduces stockouts by 30-50% and overstock by 20-30%

key_metrics.name: Website Conversion Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of website visitors who complete a purchase
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Optimize checkout, improve product pages, personalized recommendations, A/B testing

key_metrics.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Bundles, upsells, cross-sells, free shipping thresholds, loyalty programs

key_metrics.name: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)
key_metrics.description: Total revenue expected from a customer over their lifetime
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Retention marketing, subscription models, loyalty programs, post-purchase engagement

key_metrics.name: Cart Abandonment Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of shoppers who add items to cart but don't complete purchase
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Simplify checkout, offer guest checkout, abandoned cart emails, transparent pricing

key_metrics.name: Return Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of orders that are returned
key_metrics.benchmark: <15% is good for most categories, fashion averages 25-30%
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Better product photos, accurate descriptions, size guides, quality control
